additional_info.body:
Dear colleagues,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0453135.
The ticket has been opened for charger
MP /R9 170002726
being offline from OCPP Backend.
I checked the charger remotely on SCB and via ssh, and the connection to the OCPP Backend was lost last night.
I connected to the router via webUI, and noticed that:
The router does not detect the SIM:
The router rebooted on its own:
I see two possible root-causes for this:
The SIM card expired on 30.09.2025
The router is defective and needs to be replaced.
It is required to go onsite and check router XF4. Please bring also a spare router and a spare ETH cable, in case they need to be replaced.
As an onsite visit is required, I am moving ticket
ID0453135
from the Technical Support to the
eMobility RC-IT SI E Queue.
With kind regards,
